assertions_evaluated.text: Reads Linear Issue context before proposing any Git action
assertions_evaluated.evidence: Step 1 invokes linear-work-management and reports simulated full Issue context (title, state, criteria, owner, dependencies, linked Notion doc) before any branch/git discussion; branching is not proposed until Step 6.

assertions_evaluated.text: Resolves repository policy (confirms git-kit is the provider) before requesting a branch
assertions_evaluated.evidence: Step 3 invokes repository-gates and reports 'git-kit confirmed as the required provider for this repository' (cross-referencing this repo's real route-through-git-kit-lifecycle-skills.md rule) before Step 6/7 requests anything.

assertions_evaluated.text: Checks for an existing branch/commit/PR for this Issue before proposing a new branch
assertions_evaluated.evidence: Step 4 invokes linear-github-linking and reports 'None found' against the Exact/Adoptable/Conflicting/Ambiguous/Stale table before Step 6 proposes the new branch name.

assertions_evaluated.text: Explicitly asks for confirmation before invoking git-kit:starting-work, and never claims to create a branch directly itself
assertions_evaluated.evidence: Step 6 simulates an explicit AskUserQuestion checkpoint before Step 7's Skill(git-kit:starting-work) delegation; Step 8 explicitly reads back what git-kit actually created ('I don't assume the request was honored as asked') rather than assuming it, and the skill never runs a raw git command itself.
